text:
sam: Noticing a slow trickle of small-gpu pods pending in ap-southeast1c for ~30m.

nina: Any scheduler reasons?

sam: From describe: 0/20 nodes available: 8 node(s) had taint {gpu-thermal: true}, 12 node(s) didn't match pod affinity/anti-affinity rules.

leo: Sounds like classic rack affinity + taint overlap. Thermal taints during heat window create holes and our rack-first binpacking refuses to move small pods.

nina: Quick fix: relax `preferredDuringScheduling` weight for CI shards to 40 and roll 10%.

leo: Added alert idea: if pending_small_pods>=6 && headroom_pct>=25 => fire. Ops can create?

ops-bot: [system] Created alert `apse1c_tiny_fragment_v2` -> #eng-oncall. Auto-untaint job queued for 8 nodes (ETA ~2m).
